content: Since the American Diabetes Association (ADA) first introduced the Standards of Care guidelines in 1989, the approach to nutrition in diabetes management has undergone significant changes. Initially, nutritional recommendations were only briefly mentioned. However, by 2024, there has been a shift towards emphasizing overall dietary patterns rather than focusing on individual nutrients. This updated approach aligns with recommendations from other prominent organizations, such as the American Heart Association and the Kidney Disease Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO). Instead of isolating macronutrients and micronutrients, the focus is now on promoting the consumption of whole foods and encouraging balanced dietary patterns to enhance overall health outcomes.
